Goal: make my coding agents faster and cheaper: fewer model round trips, less compute and waiting, fewer failed tool calls.
Below is measured data from peektrace (last 30 days, all agents). Pick the patterns worth fixing, pull their calls with the commands at the end, and read the transcripts to find root causes. Propose concrete changes to my environment (shell config, installed tools, hooks), AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, skills or prompts that prevent it. Rank by impact; show exact edits; don't apply until I confirm.

Data (2026-09-21 → 2026-10-21):
- corpus: 1,821 transcripts (401 main, 1,420 subagent), 132 projects, 38,749 tool calls, 20h47m shell time
- avoidable retries: 1,356 round trips, 1h29m, 64.0k ctx tokens re-read
- causes (--cause id):
  - zsh-glob-flag: 1,492 hits · 678 retries (main 41 / sub 637) · 44m58s · 32.0k ctx tokens re-read · rule in memory
  - output-too-large: 1,492 hits · 678 read-backs (main 41 / sub 637) · 44m58s · 32.0k ctx tokens re-read
- failures (--fail key):
  - scan:tsc (error TS####): 206 calls, 137 sessions · 186 of 206 pipe into head/tail/grep
  - flag:Bash (Bash errors): 206 calls, 137 sessions
- shell time (--time job): wait/poll 3h39m (50.0%) · git 2h31m (12.0%)
- waiting: 643 calls, 3h39m, 307 backgrounded
- rules in memory but still firing: zsh-glob-flag (rule in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md:101 · still firing main 3/1k, sub 20/1k since 2026-10-01)
More data (--cause, --fail or --time picks the row):
- full report: peektrace stats --days 30 --json
- one row, with transcript paths: peektrace stats prompt --days 30 --cause <id>
- a row's calls: peektrace stats drill --days 30 --cause <id> --json

Pattern: unquoted glob in a flag value
- cause: zsh-glob-flag
- 913 sessions · 1,492 hits (1,457 at exit 0) · 552 sessions with a retry · 4 projects · hits main 125 / sub 1,367
- wasted: 678 retries (main 41 / sub 637) · 44m58s · 32.0k ctx tokens re-read
- culprits: *.ts ×1,196
- retries changed: --include=*.ts → --include='*.ts' ×145
- suggested fix: quote the glob
- rule in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md:101 · still firing main 3/1k, sub 20/1k since 2026-10-01
  The rule is in memory yet still fires: find why it isn't followed and fix it in a way that doesn't depend on the agent remembering (e.g. setopt nonomatch in ~/.zshenv).
Samples (failed → retry):
- 2026-10-15T07:46:55Z · toolu_01 · /home/me/.claude/projects/-home-me-work/92ea6c7d-b251-4d46-af59-c5772244e477/subagents/agent-a8cc4430796a7efce.jsonl
